title: Pride Flags
description: Add pride flags to the game, no resourcepacks required! 100% multiplayer friendly!
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d965d08f5b0def8c1630a09f9ce3426347d9dbd5.png)

[![git](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/yoavtc/pride-flags?logo=github)](https://github.com/YoavTC/pride-flags/releases) 
[![modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-gray?logo=modrinth)](modrinth.com/datapack/prideflags)
[![curseforge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-gray?logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/prideflags)
[![PM](https://img.shields.io/badge/𝗣𝗠-%20Planet%20Minecraft-gray)](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/pride-flags-6954751/)

_**Fly Your Pride!**_

Craft **10 Pride Flags** using a Stonecutter, available in both horizontal and vertical variants. Choose from the classic **Rainbow** flag or one of nine others: **Aroace**, **Aromantic**, **Asexual**, **Bisexual**, **Gay Men’s (MLM)**, **Lesbian**, **Non-binary**, **Pansexual**, and **Transgender**.

Combine 3 Leads and 3 Banners to craft the **Pride Flag Bunting**, which can be hung between two points to decorate your builds.
